money plant.water: Water when the top soil becomes dry.
money plant.problems: Yellow leaves can happen because of overwatering or poor light.

snake plant.water: Water only when the soil is completely or mostly dry.
snake plant.sunlight: It can tolerate low light and also grows well in bright indirect light.
snake plant.fertilizer: Use a mild fertilizer during active growth.
snake plant.problems: Overwatering can cause root problems and yellow leaves.

aloe vera.water: Allow the soil to dry between watering.
aloe vera.fertilizer: Use a mild succulent fertilizer occasionally.
aloe vera.problems: Soft or brown leaves can be caused by excessive watering.

rose.water: Water when the soil starts becoming dry.
rose.sunlight: Roses need several hours of sunlight.
rose.problems: Roses can have problems with pests and fungal diseases.

tulsi.water: Water when the topsoil becomes slightly dry.
tulsi.problems: Poor sunlight and improper watering can affect growth.

peace lily.water: Keep the soil slightly moist but avoid waterlogging.
peace lily.problems: Drooping can happen when the plant needs water.
